# Tool-name vocabulary for the exit audit: "<allow|deny> <name>".
#
# allow: the GitHub Copilot runtime tool names (verified against the Copilot
#        hooks reference) that generated prose may name in backticks.
# deny:  foreign (Claude Code) tool names; any backticked occurrence, alone or
#        in a "Name(args)" form, in a generated file fails the build.
#
# Never name a `skill` tool: no such Copilot tool is verified.

allow bash
allow powershell
allow view
allow create
allow edit
allow grep
allow glob
allow web_fetch
allow task
allow ask_user

deny Read
deny Write
deny Edit
deny MultiEdit
deny Bash
deny Grep
deny Glob
deny Agent
deny Task
deny Skill
deny ToolSearch
deny WebFetch
deny WebSearch
deny AskUserQuestion
deny NotebookEdit
deny TodoWrite
